title: Fourths and Fifths
description: Schema-ready drill for perfect fourths and fifths.
overview: Perfect fourths and fifths are open, stable intervals used heavily in melodies and harmony.
goal: Hear and play the difference between fourths and fifths.
instructions: Play the two highlighted notes in order.
A fourth sounds slightly closer; a fifth sounds wider and very stable.
Use the root note label to orient your hand.
